note: Capacities are minimums already used by the node baseline. Bandwidth is unmeasured. No cloud price is stated.

sharing: Three validator hosts stay isolated and are the only hosts that may hold validator keys.
bootstrap-b may share a host with rpc-a, and bootstrap-c may share a host with rpc-b. That puts public RPC beside a published P2P identity and is minimum-only.
bootstrap-a stays on its own host.
archive-a may share a host with monitoring-a. Neither may hold a validator key or a bootstrap key.

perHost.backup: Required for every validator data directory and the archive data directory.

minimumSafe.publicIp: Bootstrap and public RPC hosts only.
minimumSafe.privateNetwork: Required among the three validators. Consensus is not published on the public address.
minimumSafe.bandwidth: Unmeasured. Size for the 30-second block interval and public RPC without a figure from this repository.

recommended.sharing: None. One VM per role: validator-a/b/c, bootstrap-a/b/c, rpc-a, rpc-b, archive-a, monitoring-a.

perHost.backup: Required for validators and archive. Monitoring keeps only its own scrape state.

recommended.publicIp: Three bootstrap hosts and two public RPC hosts.
recommended.privateNetwork: Validators, archive sync, and monitoring scrapes.
